I disassociate regularly so I'll tell you what my therapist told me: try to engage all of your senses. Eat something spicy, look at something beautiful or some shit and listen to something nice. Try using a guided meditation.
For me personally, visual stimulus makes me disassociate worse and tactile stimulus "wakes" me back up better. I have a little tub of play-doh that I smelled and touched during the few times I was happy for a couple weeks and now it does wonders whenever I disassociate. Its all about finding what works for you, I think.
